notes: This skill is unavoidable but does not deal damage on hit.

entries.target: A short range status skill that applies to yourself.
entries.officialDescription: Kindle a flame within you, setting yourself ablaze. Applies Burning Ward which reduces damage taken by 40% while damaging opponents that attack you for 6 seconds, and Blazing Speed which increases haste by 15% for 14 seconds. You also use your darkness powers to restore your life from the ashes around you to apply an HoT for 8 seconds.
notes: The name of this skill is a direct reference to the Disney song Hellfire.
Applies Burning Ward to caster for 6 seconds, increasing caster's damage resistance by 40% and dealing damage to enemies that attack you.
Applies Fire in Your Skin to caster for 8 seconds, applying a HoT.
Applies Blazing Speed to caster for 14 seconds, Increasing haste by 15%.
